\needspace{7\baselineskip}\section{1. Setting specification}


\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Task}


Find an approximate first-order stationary point while minimizing the weighted number of ordinary value-gradient and rich full-Hessian queries.



\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Admissible model}


The unknown bounded-below \AtlasInlineMath{C^2} objective \AtlasInlineMath{f:\mathbb R^d\to\mathbb R} satisfies \AtlasInlineMath{f(0)-\inf f\le1}, \AtlasInlineMath{\operatorname{Lip}(\nabla f)\le1} and \AtlasInlineMath{\operatorname{Lip}(\nabla^2f)\le1}, with Euclidean operator norms. These are fixed normalized budgets; no convexity or bounded query domain is imposed.



\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Oracle interface}


An ordinary call returns \AtlasInlineMath{(f(x),\nabla f(x))} and costs one. A rich call returns \AtlasInlineMath{(f(x),\nabla f(x),\nabla^2f(x))} and costs the public price \AtlasInlineMath{\tau\ge1}. A rich call is charged once in \AtlasInlineMath{H}, not again in \AtlasInlineMath{G}. Separate value requests, if made, count as ordinary calls. Queries may be arbitrary exact-real vectors.



\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Output}


Return any measurable transcript-dependent \AtlasInlineMath{\widehat x\in\mathbb R^d}, possibly unqueried.



\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Loss or accuracy criterion}


The error is \AtlasInlineMath{\|\nabla f(\widehat x)\|_2}; success probability must be at least \AtlasInlineMath{2/3} separately for every fixed objective.



\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Resource accounting}


The weighted cost is \AtlasInlineMath{G+\tau H} and is bounded on every input and every random execution. Internal computation is free. The lower bound concerns the explicit high-dimensional regime; the deterministic upper algorithm works in every dimension.



\needspace{4\baselineskip}\subsection{Algorithm views and success guarantees}


Queries, stopping decisions and outputs are arbitrary measurable functions of the observed history and public inputs. No linear-span or zero-respecting restriction is imposed. Internal exact-real computation and storage are uncharged.



A private random seed independent of the fixed instance is permitted.




\AtlasMath{\forall f:\ \Pr(\|\nabla f(\widehat x)\|_2\le\varepsilon)\ge2/3}




Probability is over the private seed; the objective is fixed independently of that seed.



\textbf{Budget convention.} fixed\_worst\_case\_cap
